status: Conformance vectors for the informational Controller Binding v0 (spec/controller-binding-v0.md) and its use in issuer independence (evidence-interop/0, §6.7.4). Every key is a test key derived from a public seed; never use one for anything else.

test_keys.note: TEST-ONLY. Each private key is the 32-byte Ed25519 seed SHA-256(seed_label), except operator-nostr, whose BIP-340 secret key is SHA-256(seed_label).

requirements.statement: The recorded steps of each selected deal are served under a verified envelope.
The deals shown are every deal of the holder's in the period.
The step is stated by two parties.
